product_advancement_rate.definition: eligible independent product projects materially advanced by the current orchestrator run divided by independent product projects explicitly proven ELIGIBLE in the run
product_advancement_rate.unknown_policy: do not include UNKNOWN or NO_SAFE_ELIGIBLE_WORK projects in the denominator

advancement_attribution.rule: Only concrete engineering actions actually performed by the current orchestrator run count toward projects_materially_advanced, product_advancement_rate, or throughput_floor_met.
advancement_attribution.external_rule: Jeremy/manual merges, CI completions, bot actions, and other state changes observed during the run must be reported under external_state_changes and never claimed as this run's output.
advancement_attribution.continuation_rule: If an external action finishes the previously highest-priority item before or during the run, re-triage immediately and continue to the next eligible product action rather than ending the run on the external completion.

learning_evolution.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN is preferred to invented evidence

rules: orchestrator-only control-plane work never counts as product advancement
only current-run ORCHESTRATOR product actions satisfy the throughput floor
Jeremy/manual merges and external state changes are visible but do not count as current-run product advancement
eligible projects without orchestrator advancement require a concrete reason and exact next gate
Jeremy-help opportunities are reported even when they are not blockers
executive status must reflect missed repository inspection or throughput-floor violations
